'''Amit Lang''' ({{Langx|he|עמית לנג}}; born 12 October 1970) is the CEO of [[Mekorot]], the national water company of the State of Israel.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Amit Lang LinkedIn page |url=https://il.linkedin.com/in/amit-lang-257783155 |website=linkedin.com}}</ref> Before this appointment, he served in senior positions in the government and private sectors.<ref>{{Cite web |last=ROSENBAUM |first=ALAN |date=20 November 2022 |title=Mekorot CEO promotes water solutions at Global Investment Forum |url=https://www.jpost.com/environment-and-climate-change/article-722868 |website=jpost.com |access-date=17 March 2023}}</ref> Lang is a former Olympic athlete in judo and an Israel judo champion.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Speaker Details: Director General, Ministry of Economy |url=https://na.eventscloud.com/ereg/popups/speakerdetails.php?eventid=69983&speakerid=142424 |website=eventscloud.com}}</ref>

== Biography ==
In 1987, he won the under 18 world championship in Guttenberg, and in 1990 he won the bronze medal in the European Judo Championships and seventh place in the World Judo Championships.<ref name="judoinside"/> He participated in the 1992 Olympic Games.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Amit Lang |url=https://olympics.com/en/athletes/amit-lang |website=olympics.com}}</ref> in the past, he was an Israeli [[judoka]]. He competed in the [[Judo at the 1992 Summer Olympics – Men's 60 kg|men's lightweight event]] at the [[1992 Summer Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/la/amit-lang-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418050822/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/la/amit-lang-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=Amit Lang |accessdate=27 May 2018}}</ref> His highest achievement as an adult came in 1995, when he won fifth place in the European Judo Championships in Birmingham and a bronze medal in the British Open Judo Championship.<ref name="judoinside">{{Cite web |title=Amit Lang |url=https://www.judoinside.com/judoka/2764/Amit_Lang/judo-results |website=judoinside.com |access-date=17 March 2023}}</ref>

Lang began his academic studies following his retirement from judo, earning a B.A. in economics and management from the [[Academic College of Tel Aviv-Yafo]], an M.A. in economics and public policy from Tel Aviv University and an MBA with a major in finance from the College of Management Academic Studies.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Director General, Ministry of Economy |url=https://na.eventscloud.com/ereg/popups/speakerdetails.php?eventid=69983&speakerid=142424 |website=eventscloud.com}}</ref>

From 1999 to 2010, Lang worked in the Budget Department of the Ministry of Finance, where his last position was deputy director of budgets.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017 |title=The 5th Israeli Smart Energy Conference - Mr. Amit Lang |url=https://www.isea.org.il/copy-of-speakers |website=isea.org.il}}</ref> From 2010 to 2013, Lang served as deputy CEO, of economics, business development, regulation, and operator relations at Partner Communications Ltd.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2011 |title=SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION WASHINGTON, D.C. 20549 ANNUAL REPORT |url=https://www.partner.co.il/globalassets/global/investor-relations/pdfs/20-f-2011-final.pdf |website=partner.co.il |access-date=17 March 2023}}</ref> Lang returned to public service to serve as director general of the Ministry of Economy from 2013-2017.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kliner |first=Aaron |date=22 October 2015 |title=The Embassy of Israel in South Africa - INNOVATION VISA PROGRAM FOR FOREIGN ENTRPRENEURS - Minisrt of Echonomy |url=https://embassies.gov.il/pretoria/NewsAndEvents/Pages/Ministry-of-Economy.aspx |website=embassies.gov.il |access-date=17 March 2023}}</ref>

In 2018-2022, Land served as CEO of EMS Mekorot Projects Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of Mekorot National Water Company Ltd.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Rinat |first=Zafrir |date=24 February 2020 |title=National Water Project Faces Changes: Inside the Efforts to Refill Israel's Dwindling Lake Kinneret |url=https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2020-02-24/ty-article-magazine/.premium/inside-the-efforts-to-refill-israels-dwindling-lake-kinneret/0000017f-e396-d568-ad7f-f3ff115b0000 |website=haaretz.com |access-date=19 March 2023}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=RON |first=OMRI |date=9 December 2019 |title=With rains returning to Israel, cloud seeding is being renewed |url=https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/with-rains-returning-to-israel-cloud-seeding-is-being-renewed-610307 |website=jpost.com |access-date=19 March 2023}}</ref> In April 2022, Lang was appointed CEO of Mekorot. During his term, Mekorot has been recognized as one of the 60 best water companies in the world by Global Water Intelligence (GWI).<ref>{{Cite web |title=GLOBAL INVESTMENT FORUM 2022 |url=https://www.jpost.com/tags/global-investment-forum-2022 |website=jpost.com |access-date=17 March 2023}}</ref>

Lang was appointed CEO of Mekorot National Water Company Ltd in April 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Noviik |first=Lior |date=1 May 2023 |title='There will be no water shortage in Israel' |url=https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/energy-and-infrastructure/article-741756#google_vignette |website=jpost.com |access-date=28 February 2024}}</ref>

During his term, Mekorot has chalked up numerous and diverse achievements:

Mekorot has been recognized as one of the 60 best water companies in the world by Global Water Intelligence (GWI), the international organization that incorporates the operations of hundreds of private and public water companies.<ref>{{Cite web |last=JERUSALEM POST STAFF |date=22 May 2022 |title=Mekorot named as one of world's top water companies |url=https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/energy-and-infrastructure/article-707607 |website=jpost.com}}</ref>

The company’s international operations were also expanded,<ref>{{Cite web |last=JERUSALEM POST STAFF |date=24 March 2023 |title=Mekorot head announces establishment of International Water Forum at UN Water Conference |url=https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/energy-and-infrastructure/article-735322 |website=jpost.com}}</ref>

advanced technologies were installed, investments in Israeli startup, with an emphasis on energy efficiency, were moved forward.<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 March 2023 |title=Mekorot invests in Olive Diagnostics to allow early detection of chemicals in water reservoirs |url=https://techtime.news/2023/03/13/olive-diagnostics-2/ |website=techtime.news}}</ref>

The company also chalked up important regulator achievements in the annual budget arrangements law and changes were made to water rules. The company has maintained its AAAil credit rating. and, for the first time, was ranked in the ten best companies to work for by CofaceBDi.
